data.name: Christoph
data.gender_notes: Christoph is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek 'Christophoros', meaning 'bearer of Christ'. This name is given in honor of St. Christopher, a 3rd-century saint venerated for carrying a child across a river, symbolizing his role in supporting and protecting believers on their spiritual journey. The name Christoph carries the meaning “Bearer of Christ” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Christoph usually hope their child will grow to embody bearer of christ and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Christoph belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Bearer of Christ.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Christoph total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_latin.name: Christoph
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Christoph originates from the Latin words 'Christum' and 'ferens', meaning bearer of Christ. It represents the individual who carries the message of Christ to the world.

in_english.name: Christoph
in_english.long_meaning: The name Christoph is derived from the Greek words 'Christos' (Χριστός) and 'phoros' (φορά), meaning bearer or carrier of Christ. It symbolizes the person who brings the message of Christ. Historically, the name Christoph has been used in Christian tradition to signify a person who carries the spiritual legacy of Christ. It is associated with qualities of leadership, faith, and spirituality.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Christoph" is rooted in the rich history and cultural traditions of early Christianity. It reflects the deep reverence and devotion of early believers towards St. Christopher, who became a symbol of protection, strength, and faith. This name remains a testament to the enduring influence of religious figures in shaping personal and societal values.

It is a call for the bearer to live their life in accordance with the virtues of this venerated saint. They are encouraged to be selfless, caring individuals who go to great lengths to ensure the spiritual growth and well-being of those around them. NS3: Furthermore, the name 'Christoph' acts as a reminder of the power and presence of God in the lives of believers. This name instills a sense of connection to the divine and encourages individuals to seek and maintain a strong spiritual relationship with God.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Christoph means "bearing Christ," symbolizing the Christian's commitment to carry the teachings and love of Christ in their daily life.
